title: Our statutory health insurance partner | EC Assets
description: Meet the statutory health insurer behind the public cover in the EC Assets {{product}}: a large, highly rated insurer with English-speaking service, a bonus programme and dental cover.

blocks.html: The public cover in our packages comes from one of Germany's large statutory health insurers, an organisation that serves a large share of the country's international students and professionals.
Because so many of our customers end up as its members, we think it deserves a proper introduction. Here is what to expect from the insurer that may become part of your everyday life in Germany.
One of the leading statutory health insurers in Germany
It is known for practical things: service in several languages, an app that works in English, and fast responses.
The reputation rests on practical things: service in several languages, an app that works in English, reliable cover for employees, families and students, and fast responses.
Service is the focus, and that is what keeps the insurer at the top of the German rankings.
Under German federal law the insurer provides statutory cover, including doctor and dentist visits and prescription medication.

blocks.text: How do I join the bonus programme?

blocks.html: The bonus programme is open to every member. You collect points for check-ups, vaccinations and sport, and convert them into rewards.
Certificates, claims, appointments and messages to the insurer, all in English, on your phone.
Yes. Check-ups are covered in full, and the insurer contributes to fillings, crowns and dentures. Complex procedures may involve a co-payment, but routine dental work is included.
All vaccinations recommended by the German standing committee on vaccination, plus travel vaccinations for private trips under the standard tariff.

blocks.text: How do I become a member?

blocks.html: The quickest way is through EC Assets. Start on our health insurance page. If you also need a Blocked Account for your visa, the {{product}} covers both in one application.
The EC Assets health insurance bundle combines this cover with travel health insurance and a few extras chosen for newcomers.
